purpose: Synthetic, bounded review cases derived from release-acceptance failure patterns. No real company claims or interactions.

cases.source: Backend Engineer. Work remotely within the Americas and Europe. Our offices are in New York and Columbus. The employer serves U.S. customers.
cases.proposed_claim: This vacancy explicitly accepts U.S. hires because the company has U.S. offices.

reference.why: Office presence and customer market do not establish the role's permitted hiring countries.
reference.correction: Americas/Europe remote scope is observed; specific countries and engagement arrangements remain unknown. LATAM eligibility is possible, not confirmed.

cases.source: Our team works from Brazil, Argentina and the United States. Backend Engineer: remote within Americas time zones.
cases.proposed_claim: They directly employ LATAM engineers and therefore do not use recruiting suppliers.

reference.why: Team locations do not establish employment arrangements, recruiting partners or supplier appetite.
reference.correction: LATAM team presence is observed. Direct employment, contractors and supplier use remain unknown. A partner-fit hypothesis needs a separate incremental-value basis.

cases.source: A recruiting agency lists posting A, Backend Engineer, and posting B, Full Stack Engineer, in Austin. Both mention a confidential technology client. No requisition identifiers or client names are published.
cases.proposed_claim: These are definitely the same client's duplicate vacancy. Alternatively we can pitch two distinct hires.

reference.why: Neither duplicate identity, shared client identity nor distinct requisitions is supported by these listings.
reference.correction: Two published listings may overlap. Discuss either search without asserting a shared client or exact number of hires.

cases.source: A U.S. technology recruiting firm publishes a current backend search for a client. Remote within the United States only; current U.S. work authorization required. No delivery-partner policy is published.
cases.proposed_claim: This is a confirmed LATAM-serviceable opening and the agency wants a delivery partner.

reference.why: The observed vacancy is restricted. Partnership appetite is unknown and must not be manufactured from client demand.
reference.correction: Record restricted client demand. A supported future partnership hypothesis may permit provisional exploration; do not offer LATAM candidates for this restricted vacancy.
